aurora_onboard: Hey CS/Eng — onboarding smoke test with Rust SDK hitting a churny 429 pattern. We spin up 30 short-lived edge workers and each calls prefetch_at_start(). At ~160 rps sustained we see a ripple of 429s to /v1/complete and some 503s. Any quick mitigations?

cassandra_cs: Sorry you're seeing this. Which rust-sdk version and auth mode? Do workers reuse connections or open fresh channels?

aurora_onboard: Using rust-sdk 0.2.0, long-lived project key in env. Each worker spawns and immediately calls client.prefetch_at_start(). No splay and we create a new hyper client per worker (so no connection reuse).

yuri_eng: Classic thundering herd + connection churn. Quick steps: 1) stop eager prefetch on spawn or add randomized startup jitter (0-8s) 2) reuse an http client across workers (keep-alive) 3) enable client-side token cache (single-process) so only one fetch happens on cache miss 4) add 429 retry with exponential backoff + jitter.

pat_rust: Minimal Rust snippet to switch to lazy single-flight fetch and shared client:```rust
let shared_client = Arc::new(RwLock::new(Redwood::new(api_key)));
async fn token_for(req_id: u64, client: Arc<RwLock<Redwood>>) -> String {
  if let Some(t) = client.read().await.token_cache.get() { return t.clone() }
  // single-flight: only one fetch will populate
  let mut w = client.write().await;
  if w.token_cache.is_none() { w.fetch_ephemeral().await.unwrap(); }
  w.token_cache.clone().unwrap()
}
```Also set hyper pool to reuse connections and limit new sockets per sec.

cassandra_cs: We can also flip a tenant flag to coalesce preflight calls server-side for a short window while you roll this change. Want that?

aurora_onboard: Yes please — enable coalescing for 4h. We'll implement the shared client + splay now and run a canary.

cicd-bot: feature preflight_coalesce enabled for tenant aurora_onboard until ts=3120018955.

aurora_onboard: After changes (shared client + 0-6s splay + retry/backoff) the 429s essentially disappeared. Sample logs:```log
[3120005591] worker-12 start splay=4.1s
[3120005596] token: cache miss -> fetched
[3120005602] complete:200 latency=132ms
```Huge help — thanks!

yuri_eng: Follow-up runbook we'll drop: rust-sdk best practices (shared hyper client, single-flight token cache, startup_splay=0-8s, keep_alive=true, max_connections tuned, retry{base:150ms,max:10s,jitter:true}). Also note to request a permanent preflight quota bump if you expect many simultaneous cold boots.

cassandra_cs: Adding onboarding note to account health: "onboarding-risk: mitigated; will re-evaluate after canary completes". Please paste a short postmortem after your rollout so renewal team has context.
